title: Fee Schedule for Changes and Re-registration, Resort Lodging
content:
Two fees and one notice period are published for every Resort Lodging unit type. The change fee is the fee in USD for changing the dates, the unit type or the party size on a firm reservation. The change notice period is the number of calendar days before arrival by which a change must be recorded. Re-registration to a different lead guest is published as permitted or not permitted for the unit type, and where it is permitted it carries a re-registration fee in USD.

| Unit type | Change fee (USD) | Change notice period (calendar days) | Re-registration permitted | Re-registration fee (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Base Village Inn Room | 35.00 | 3 | yes | 25.00 |
| Slopeside Studio | 45.00 | 7 | yes | 35.00 |
| Slopeside One-Bedroom Residence | 65.00 | 10 | yes | 45.00 |
| Slopeside Two-Bedroom Residence | 65.00 | 10 | yes | 45.00 |
| Mountain Lodge Suite | 85.00 | 14 | no | 95.00 |
| Summit Penthouse Residence | 150.00 | 21 | no | 195.00 |
| Private Mountain Chalet | 350.00 | 30 | no | 395.00 |

### Notes on the schedule

The change fee and the re-registration fee are distinct figures published side by side; for the Slopeside One-Bedroom Residence they stand at 65.00 USD and 45.00 USD. A re-registration fee is published for all seven unit types, including the three for which re-registration to a different lead guest is not permitted: the Mountain Lodge Suite, the Summit Penthouse Residence and the Private Mountain Chalet.
